explanation: Shrinks VIA_VIA23_1_3_36_36 M3 land y-extent from ±56 to ±36 dbu (aligning M3 y-edges with V2 cut y-edges) to clear 24 admissible V2.M3.AUX.2 violations block-wide; extends four M4 polygons rightward (172–192 dbu) to bring parallel run to exactly 176 dbu for four M4.S.5 violations; extends two M3 polygon tops by 9 dbu to convert their adjacent edge from TIP (≤144 dbu) to SIDE (>144 dbu), switching the applicable rule from M3.S.2 (100 dbu) to M3.S.1 (72 dbu) so the 92 dbu gap passes; and extends one M2 polygon left by 48 dbu to raise the parallel run to 140 dbu for the M2.S.7 compound rule.
